To,
All Regional Provident Fund Commissioners 2 5 JAN 2016

In Charge of Regional/Sub-Regional Offices

Subject : Instructions on handling legal cases where cause of action lies
with EPFO and UOT is a respondent- regarding.

Sir,

It has been experienced that the Union of India is invariably impleaded as
Proforma party in cases at different legal forum and the instructions to delete the name
of Union of India, has already been circulated vide circular No. LC-
4(7)2010/GI/HC/Pt.2/4329 dated 22.05.2014.

2. However Ministry of Labour & Employment vide its letter No. S-35018/8/2015-
SS.II dated 12.01.2016 has requested to ensure deletion the name of Union of India
and Secretary (L&E) in all such cases at the earliest wherin cause of action lies with the
EPFO and Union of India has also been made party.

3, It is therefore requested that the above instructions must be followed unfailingly.

Yours faithfully,

or

Addl. Central P. F. Commissioner (HQ)

Copy to: All Addl. CPFCs (Zone) for information and necessary action.
